items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice Sanjay Kumar Agrawal as Chief Justice of Rajasthan High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Justice Sanjay Kumar Agrawal as the Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court. Justice Agrawal is currently the Acting Chief Justice of the Chhattisgarh High Court. He was elevated as an additional judge of that Court in September 2013 and made a permanent judge in March 2016. His elevation as Chief Justice comes amid a controversy over the conduct of the present Acting Chief Justice of the Rajasthan High Court, Justice Sanjeev Prakash Sharma . Supreme Court Justice Sandeep Mehta had recently written to Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant seeking Justice Sharma's transfer out of Rajasthan and appointment of a regular Chief Justice from another High Court. Justice Mehta had raised allegations concerning Justice Sharma's exercise of administrative powers and the listing of cases. The controversy also triggered protests by lawyers at both the Jaipur and Jodhpur benches of the Rajasthan High Court, with lawyers demanding that Justice Sharma be divested of his charge as Acting Chief Justice. Justice Sharma, who is set to retire later this month, has denied the allegations against him.

items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi as Chief Justice of Bombay High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Allahabad High Court Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi as the new Chief Justice of the Bombay High Court. Justice Tripathi will be the 50th Chief Justice of the High Court and the second Chief Justice from Allahabad High Court. The recommendation for his appointment as the Chief Justice was made by the Supreme Court Collegium at a meeting held on August 6. Justice Tripathi graduated in law from Lucknow University in 1990. He enrolled as an advocate on January 11, 1992. His practice was mainly on the civil side. He served as the additional chief standing counsel for the State of Uttar Pradesh since October 2007. He also appeared as counsel for the Kanpur Development Authority, Kanpur Nagar Nigam, UP Food and Essential Commodities Corporation, Agra Development Authority, Moradabad Development Authority and Kumaun University. Justice Tripathi was elevated as an additional judge of the Allahabad High Court on September 27, 2013. He was made a permanent judge on April 10, 2015. Bombay High Court is currently functioning with 74 judges as against its sanctioned strength of 94 judges.

items.title: Centre notifies appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra as Chief Justice of Punjab & Haryana HC
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra as the Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court. Justice Mishra is currently serving as the Acting Chief Justice of the High Court. The Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his elevation as the Chief Justice of the Punjab and Haryana High Court on August 06. Justice Mishra, who obtained his LL.B. from Delhi University's Campus Law Centre, was appointed as an additional judge of the Allahabad High Court on February 3, 2014, and was made a permanent judge on February 1, 2016. He served at the Allahabad High Court up to July 20, 2025 before being transferred to the Punjab and Haryana High Court, where he joined on July 21, 2025. He was appointed acting Chief Justice on June 1 following the elevation of then Chief Justice Sheel Nagu to the Supreme Court.

items.title: Centre clears appointment of Justice Krushna Ram Mohapatra as Chief Justice of Chhattisgarh High Court
items.summary: The Central government had cleared the appointment of Orissa High Court judge Justice Krushna Ram Mohapatra as Chief Justice of the High Court of Chhattisgarh. The appointment was announced on X by Union Minister of State for Law Arjun Ram Meghwal on Saturday night. In exercise of the power conferred by the Constitution of India, in consultation with the Chief Justice of India, the President is pleased to appoint the following High Court Judges as Chief Justices of the High Courts: pic.twitter.com/yggIOo1B7Q — Arjun Ram Meghwal (@arjunrammeghwal) September 5, 2026 The recommendation was made at a Collegium meeting held on August 6 and was consequent upon the retirement of then Chief Justice Ramesh Sinha on September 4. Justice Mohapatra worked as Additional Standing Counsel for the State as well as the Orissa Public Service Commission, and served as advocate for entities including Central Cooperative Banks Limited (Keonjhar), the National Institute of Open Schooling under the Ministry of HRD, Neelachal Ispat Nigam Limited, and Bank of Baroda. He was elevated as a judge of the Orissa High Court on April 17, 2015 where he has been serving till date.

items.title: Justice RV Ghuge appointed Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Bombay High Court Justice Ravindra V Ghuge as the Chief Justice of the Calcutta High Court. Justice Ghuge is presently serving as the acting Chief Justice of Bombay High Court. A Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his elevation as the Chief Justice of Calcutta High Court on August 6. Justice Ghuge completed his law education from MP Law College in Aurangabad in 1990. He joined the Bar in 1990 and was elevated as the judge of the Bombay High Court in 2013. He was appointed as acting Chief Justice of the High Court after Chief Justice Shree Chandrashekhar was elevated to Supreme Court in June this year.

items.title: Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati appointed Chief Justice of J&K and Ladakh High Court
items.summary: The Central government on Saturday cleared the appointment of Justice Pushpendra Singh Bhati as the Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh. Justice Bhati is currently a judge of the Rajasthan High Court. The Supreme Court Collegium had recommended his name for Chief Justice of J&K and Ladakh High Court on August 31. Justice Bhati will now take over as the Chief Justice from Justice Sanjeev Kumar who has been serving as acting Chief Justice of the High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh since June 2. Justice Bhati was a lawyer practicing across several areas of law for nearly 25 years before he was elevated to the bench of the Rajasthan High Court on November 16, 2016. As a lawyer, he served as a Additional Advocate General for the State and was elected as President of the High Court Lawyers Association at different points Justice Bhati's wife, Justice Nupur Bhati, was also elevated as a judge of the Rajasthan High Court in 2023.
